method: All72 actual raw responses, complete source/context, source-relative hypotheses, decisions, edited source and final bodies personally inspected. User-letter-normalization-v1 frozen before inference. Local spelling repair is scored independently from whole-body fidelity. Quote payload and typographic delimiters distinguished; this is not verbatim-mode acceptance. No independent blind review.
